description: Product knowledge base for Sofia Vargas. A selling script may state ONLY what is written here. Anything left null is treated as unknown, and the guard blocks a script that states it anyway — so a blank price is not a gap to fill in, it is an instruction not to quote one.
how_to_use: Fill in the fields you can verify from the product's own materials. Leave the rest null.
Pick the product in the studio window, write the brief, press 'Write it for me'.
The script writer receives these fields as facts and is told everything else is unknown.
check_reply() then verifies the output: a price or link that is NOT in this file is
blocked as invented, and any guaranteed-return or risk-free claim is blocked outright —
including when the product's own marketing makes it.

products.compliance_note: If this turns out to be a token, coin, or any product sold on the prospect of financial gain, a scripted endorsement is regulated marketing in most jurisdictions — Taiwan included — and separate from anything this repo's guards can decide. The guards will block guaranteed-return and risk-free claims automatically, but they cannot tell you whether the promotion itself is permitted, whether a disclosure is required, or whether the KOL persona may lawfully make it. Get that answered before recording, not after.
